primary_task: Export an Expo web app/API routes and deploy it to EAS Hosting with eas deploy (preview and production), managing env secrets.

requirements.name: node/npx
requirements.evidence: npx expo export -p web; npx eas-cli@latest deploy

requirements.name: eas-cli
requirements.evidence: npm install -g eas-cli; eas login; npx eas-cli@latest deploy --prod
requirements.check: command -v eas; npm view eas-cli version

requirements.name: expo (CLI)
requirements.check: command -v expo; npm view expo version

requirements.name: api.expo.dev
requirements.evidence: EAS Hosting deploys your Expo web app and API routes to Expo's managed edge

notes: Authoring API routes and local `npx expo serve` testing would work, but the primary deploy workflow requires Expo's API (blocked) and an Expo login (none).
